dragon.model.markdownDescription: Default model as `provider/model` (for example `ollama/qwen2.5-coder:7b` or `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`). Used by the chat view and the OpenCode TUI. Leave empty to use OpenCode's own default.

dragon.compaction.autoAt.markdownDescription: Compact a conversation automatically once it fills this percentage of the model's context window. OpenCode compacts sooner when the model needs the rest for its reply. `0` turns automatic compaction off, also when a request no longer fits. The `/autocompact` chat command changes this.

dragon.agents.maxWakes.description: How many times other agents may start a turn for an agent before a person has to continue it. Your next message to the agent, to its team's lead or to an agent that started one of its turns resets the count.

dragon.agents.worktreesFolder.markdownDescription: The folder that **Dragon: New Agent** makes each agent's Git worktree in. Empty means `.dragon/worktrees` in your home folder.

dragon.agents.sandbox.markdownDescription: Run agents' shell commands in a macOS sandbox that keeps them to the folders open in the window. They cannot read or change the rest of your home folder or other disks, open apps, or use the clipboard, the keychain, other apps' preferences or Unix sockets such as Docker's and ssh-agent's, and they get a home folder of their own. Applies when OpenCode next starts (**Dragon: Restart OpenCode**). Linux and Windows have no such sandbox.

dragon.agents.maxTeammates.description: The most teammates the lead of a team may start.

enumDescriptions: OpenCode plans and answers but may not change files or run commands; kept to the open project.
OpenCode asks in the chat before it edits files or runs commands; kept to the open project.
OpenCode edits files and runs commands without asking, but only inside the open project, never the rest of your disk.
OpenCode edits files and runs commands without asking, and can reach your whole disk.
dragon.permissionMode.description: How much OpenCode may do without asking, and whether it is kept to the open project. The chip in the chat composer cycles this setting.

dragon.workingDirectory.description: Directory OpenCode works in. Defaults to the first workspace folder.

dragon.opencode.path.description: Path to an `opencode` binary to use instead of the bundled one.

dragon.ollama.enabled.description: Detect a local Ollama daemon and offer its models.

dragon.ollama.origin.description: Where Ollama listens. Only loopback addresses are used.

dragon.instantGrep.enabled.markdownDescription: Replace OpenCode's `grep` and `glob` with **Instant Grep**: a local trigram index (never uploaded) that answers regex searches in milliseconds, with results verified by ripgrep. Also adds `find_files` for fuzzy file lookup.

dragon.semanticSearch.enabled.markdownDescription: Give OpenCode `codebase_search`: find code by meaning with a local embedding model served by Ollama, fused with Instant Grep keyword matches. The workspace is embedded on this machine in the background; nothing is uploaded. Needs Ollama and `#dragon.instantGrep.enabled#`.

dragon.semanticSearch.model.markdownDescription: Ollama embedding model for `codebase_search`, for example `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`, `nomic-embed-text` or `embeddinggemma`. Changing it re-embeds the workspace. Run **Dragon: Set Up Semantic Search** to download it.

dragon.updates.check.markdownDescription: Once a day, check for a newer Dragon IDE release and offer to download it. The check is one anonymous request to the release feed in `product.json` (GitHub releases). Nothing is downloaded without a click.

dragon.completions.enabled.markdownDescription: Suggest code as you type (ghost text; press Tab to accept) with a small local model through Ollama. Nothing is sent anywhere else. Runs only when `#dragon.completions.model#` is installed: run **Dragon: Set Up Tab Completions**.

dragon.completions.model.markdownDescription: Ollama model for Tab completions. It must support fill-in-the-middle, like `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b` (fast) or `qwen2.5-coder:7b` (better, slower).

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Dragon IDE
walkthroughs.description: Pick a model, meet your OpenCode agent, get Tab completions, set the agent's limits and search your code by meaning.

steps.title: Pick a model
steps.description:
Run a model on this machine with Ollama, connect an API key, or sign in to a provider.
[Choose a Model](command:dragon.chooseModel)

steps.title: Chat with your agent
steps.description:
Ask @dragon to explain, fix or build something. Tool calls stream in as live cards, and edits arrive as a diff.
[Open the Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

steps.title: Tab completions
steps.description:
Ghost-text suggestions as you type, from a small model on this machine. Press Tab to accept.
[Set Up Tab Completions](command:dragon.completions.setup)

steps.title: Decide how much it may do
steps.description:
Read-Only, Ask, Project Only or Full Access. Project Only lets agents work without asking but keeps them to the open project; Full Access reaches your whole disk. Switch with the chip in the chat composer.
[Open the Setting](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22dragon.permissionMode%22%5D)

steps.title: Continue in the terminal
steps.description:
The OpenCode TUI shares sessions with the chat.
[Open the OpenCode TUI](command:dragon.openTui)

steps.title: Search by meaning
steps.description:
Instant Grep is already on. Add semantic search, which uses a local embedding model.
[Set Up Semantic Search](command:dragon.semanticSearch.setup)
